exposure: parity (second labor, third labor, fourth labor)
cohort: 1584 women in their second, third, or fourth labors who delivered between January 2012 and December 2016.
finding: Women in their second labor were more likely to have longer labor durations and a higher risk of cesarean delivery compared to women in their third or fourth labor.
mod_finding: Women in their second labor had a higher rate of cesarean delivery compared to those in their third or fourth labor.
